title: y as a Vowel
rule: At the end of a short word, y says long i, like fly. At the end of a longer word, y usually says long e, like baby.
trickText: Count the syllables. One syllable, like fly? y says long i. Two syllables, like baby? y usually says long e.
say: Today's case: the vowel y. In a short word like fly, y says long i. At the end of a longer word like baby, y says long e. Listen for the sound.

activities.instruction: Listen to the y at the end. Does it say long i, or long e?

categories.label: Long i (fly)
categories.why: A one-syllable word ending in y: y says long i.

categories.label: Long e (baby)
categories.why: At the end of a longer word, y usually says long e.
